name: Chen's Empty Keg
summary: A keg bearing Chen Stormstout’s mark lies abandoned in the Barrens. Its discovery points toward the wandering brewmaster’s old ties to Durotar.

sections.title: A Wandering Relic
sections.body: Travelers sometimes find an abandoned wooden barrel across the dry Barrens. Razormane quilboar and Kolkar centaur leave ordinary casks behind, but this barrel is carefully made and bears a plaque: “Chen Stormstout - May your spirit be raised and always raise your spirits.” It is an odd relic beneath Kalimdor’s sun. To learn how it came to the Barrens, you seek someone who knows brewing.

sections.title: Echoes of Durotar's Founding
sections.body: Brewmaster Drohn in Ratchet recognizes the keg’s craftsmanship and names Chen Stormstout as its owner. Chen, a wandering Pandaren, traveled with Rexxar during the battles that secured Durotar for Thrall’s Horde. Years have passed since Chen walked Kalimdor’s red earth, yet seasoned brewers still remember his recipes and wandering spirit.

faq.answer: It is an abandoned brewing barrel found in the Barrens. Its inscription honors the wandering Pandaren brewmaster Chen Stormstout.
Chen Stormstout is a wandering Pandaren brewmaster who traveled across Kalimdor. He is best known for helping Rexxar, a half-ogre beastmaster, defend and establish Durotar.

faq.q: Who should I take the keg to?
faq.answer: Take the keg to Brewmaster Drohn, an orc brewer stationed along the road near Ratchet. He recognizes Chen’s mark and knows how to recreate his recipes.

faq.q: Why is Chen's keg lying out in the Barrens?
faq.answer: Chen roamed Kalimdor years ago in search of exotic brewing ingredients. He traveled while helping the young Horde secure its homeland against Admiral Proudmoore’s forces.

faq.q: Does Chen Stormstout appear in person?
faq.answer: No. Chen has left the region and has not been seen in Kalimdor for a long time. His old barrels, recipes, and the fond memories of allies like Drohn and Rexxar remain.

faq.q: What does Brewmaster Drohn do with the keg?
faq.answer: Drohn welcomes the relic and challenges adventurous wanderers to gather local beast ingredients. He plans to use them to recreate Chen’s potent, legendary brews.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you can remember Chen Stormstout as an honored ally who fought beside Rexxar and Rokhan to establish Durotar and protect the Horde in its earliest days.
As a cook, you can see Chen’s keg as the legacy of an artisan brewer. His palate and search for rare ingredients inspired craftsmen across Kalimdor.
